project.description: vexelray-gui-nfd on Linux: the NFDe library built for Linux (NFDe 1.3.0's xdg-desktop-portal backend over D-Bus, so the desktop's own file chooser) and the facts about it that differ per OS, as an NfdPlatform found through ServiceLoader. vexelray-gui-nfd's OS-activated build profile adds this as a runtime dependency.
